label: Obesity prevalence among adults (BMI >= 30)
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = the NCD Risk Factor Collaboration's adult BMI pooled analysis (measured population-based surveys re-analyzed), republished by WHO GHO as NCD_BMI_30C — the crude 18+ face, 199 countries, 1980-2024, full sex-split, on the provider's own API wire (the 2026 vintage, lastUpdated 2026-05-22, read live). A modeled-estimates canonical by necessity: no collector prints the prevalence anywhere (the WB probe record); the OWID chart door prints the same series bit-identically (verified on the live anchors — the same-root relation recorded) and is refused as an auto-witness. No witness tier. The top_income_share constitution (v19): the authoritative compilation displayed as what it is.

notes: THE TODD ARC PRINTS ITSELF (todd_refs: 3 citations, La Défaite de l'Occident): the book's health-paradox pair — USA 41.8 vs FRANCE 12.5 (2024, both sexes crude) — rides the door directly at the population level (the book's own face is the CDC's college- educated comparison, a survey-microdata cut this door does not print — the paradox's educated-vs-general seam documented, the same way the by-origin migration faces are registered). JAPAN 5.2 prints the lean counter-example the book's East Asia argument leans on; RUSSIA 21.2, GERMANY 24.5, and the measured arc 1980-> 2024 (FRA 10.6 -> 12.5, USA 11.8 -> 41.8 — the fourfold American rise IS the anomie-of-abundance curve). THE SEX SPLIT rides the canonical tier itself (the merge key keeps male/female/both apart): the American female 43.0 vs male 40.6 (2024) inversion prints beside the French near-parity (12.6/12.5). THE HONEST LIMITS: a modeled-estimates canonical (the pooled analysis' own confidence intervals dropped at parse with every GHO door — the connector's standing record); the crude-vs-age-standardized seam (NCD_BMI_30A registered non-wired — the standardization redistributes the age structure, ~1-2 points on the co-covered core); the college-educated face and the by-survey self-reported faces are BOOK/curated territory (registered future doors); no witness tier (the same-root absence recorded above).
